docs(plans): queue the mascot dock icon, the installer window, and the icon spike

The desktop bucket gains three owner-added items: the packager passes no icon
so the dock tile is Electrons default; the release DMG already carries the
Applications symlink and only lacks its window presentation; and a spike to
judge whether a host image model can produce a sidebar icon set worth keeping.
